title: HarnessGroup
responsibility: Groups catalog, relationship and style contents under an accessible default-open collapse control.

inputs.name: HarnessGroup.title
inputs.description: The required text rendered inside the group heading. It is displayed alongside the count.

inputs.name: HarnessGroup.count
inputs.description: The required numeric value rendered beside the title. The component does not normalize or validate it.

inputs.name: HarnessGroup.icon
inputs.description: An optional HarnessIconName rendered beside the title when truthy. If omitted, no group icon is rendered.

inputs.name: HarnessGroup.source
inputs.description: An optional string passed as the heading element's title attribute. If omitted, the component passes undefined.

inputs.name: HarnessGroup.description
inputs.description: An optional paragraph rendered above the children when truthy. An empty string or omitted value renders no paragraph.

inputs.name: HarnessGroup.level
inputs.description: Selects the heading element: 2 renders h2 and 3 renders h3. Defaults to 2.

inputs.name: HarnessGroup.variant
inputs.description: The section class value, limited to catalog, relation, or styles. Defaults to catalog.

inputs.name: HarnessGroup.resetKey
inputs.description: A scope string whose changes reset the group to expanded; an unchanged value does not reset a user collapse. Defaults to the empty string.

inputs.name: HarnessGroup.children
inputs.description: The required Svelte snippet rendered inside the body. The body remains mounted while collapsed and is hidden with the hidden attribute.

outputs.name: HarnessGroup
outputs.description: Renders a section with an h2 or h3 heading and a button that controls the body. The button exposes aria-expanded and aria-controls, and toggles the body's hidden state while children remain rendered.
